item.title: 2016 Ford Focus RS
item.description: This 2016 Ford Focus RS was ordered with the RS2 package and was sold new at Corwin Ford Republic in Missouri, and it was later registered in California and Florida before its December 2022 acquisition by the seller. Now indicating 78k miles, the car is finished in Nitrous Blue Metallic Quad-Coat over Charcoal Black leather and microsuede. item.description: This 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera coupe was initially delivered to Sonnen Porsche of San Rafael, California, and shows 31k miles following registration history in California and Oregon. item.title: 57-Years-Owned 1967 Chevrolet Corvette Convertible 327/350 4-Speed
item.description: This 1967 Chevrolet Corvette convertible was produced on June 6, 1967, and initially delivered to Don Allen Chevrolet in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It was acquired by the current owner the following year and has since undergone two periods of refurbishment work, most recently in 2016. Power is provided by a 327ci V8 that is backed by a four-speed manual transmission, and the car is finished in green over black upholstery and has a black soft top. item.title: 1995 BMW 850CSi 6-Speed
item.description: This 1995 BMW 850CSi is one of 225 examples built for the US market during a two-year production run, and it has 56k miles.
